items.summary: Disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta/full launch and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for any Woot permission, public-display, affiliate, advertising, or data-rights decision. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not redistribution, storage, derivative, caching, alert, trademark/image/price, affiliate, or advertising rights; current public terms restrict those uses. SearchWoot rights, accuracy/freshness, security, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Current compliance baseline is technical only: 37 pass, 15 fail, 7 unknown; incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth, but failed or unknown compliance gates remain site-specific blockers. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, keep permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization, and permit only bounded reversible work preserving consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Progress is limited to official Woot documentation, public terms/support evidence, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft site terms. No task is closable because rights, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, and incident procedures remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness and rollback evidence. Do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, launch state, or send outreach.

Data-use dispositions: 1) Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission/API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price terms, and affiliate/advertising rights. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. 2) User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, Slack/email processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. 3) GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal capture, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, vendor disclosure verification, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture current consent/configuration evidence without enabling new tracking. 4) Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms/DPA coverage, incident response, breach, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: attach a read-only log/vendor/incident inventory. No data-use item is clear or conditionally cleared for public beta.

Retain complicated.work parked: current compliance check fails banner and consent accept/reject and GA4 checks; next evidence action is isolated remediation followed by the same compliance rerun. Retain deadlymaracas.com parked: DNS fetch failed, so reachability, disclosures, consent, analytics, monetization, and launch evidence are unknown; next evidence action is a dated reachability, disclosure, consent, analytics, terms, monetization, and explicit launch-decision checklist. Do not infer adult, age-sensitive, regulated, or NSFW status from domain names. Other ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally where existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved.

Analytics is broadly configured, but the data-quality contract is yellow because some GA4/GSC sources fail or lack permission; do not treat failures as zero. Revenue evidence is partial: Amazon reports $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 with 28 ordered items and 6 shipped items, not site-attributable; do not infer site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, or causal lift. Operations deploy-health, uptime, error sweeps, and fleet-doctor have no results, so no fleet-wide legal or security clearance is supported. These gaps do not independently block ordinary reversible growth that adds no new data collection, permissions, credentials, dependencies, monetization, or public rights-dependent claims.
